messages:
Priya K (PM): Quick sync 024-09-10: Execs want a one-slide explanation of whats in MVP vs v1 and why were deferring certain items. We also need a fallback plan if infra quota stays constrained.

Gabe R (Eng): From engineerings view: non-negotiables for MVP = routing, per-tenant model pinning, and basic tracing. Heavy items (global embeddings cache, quantized kernels) should move to v1.

Sofia M (Eng-ML): Agree. I'll add that model regression harness for pinned models is MVP-scoped; broader continuous evals are v1. The harness has to run before any pin swap.

Lena T (ProdOps): Ops needs: a clear canary cadence, rollback plan, and a pilot flag in the console so sales can limit exposure. We can fake metrics in the UI for demo but must label them.

Ravi S (QA): QA note: if we trim the cache work, add stress tests around routing fallbacks. We saw flakiness last time when cache misses spiked.

Priya K (PM): Two options: 1) reserve limited GPUs for pilot tenants (ops work, extra risk), or 2) deliver a narrow tenant-scoped prefix cache + throttled fallback for public tenants (simpler). Which minimizes timeline risk?

Gabe R (Eng): Option 2 is lower-risk. Prefix cache (LRU by prefix hash, 2min TTL) scoped to pilot tenants is quick to implement and reduces infra changes. Throttled fallback can be a simple token-bucket per-tenant.

Sofia M (Eng-ML): We should also add a temporary metric that flags cache-induced skew on outputs. If cache changes output distribution by >5% we roll back the cache for that tenant.

Lena T (ProdOps): I'll add pilot flag in the console and endpoint to toggle throttling. UX will show a "pilot" badge + tooltip explaining limits.

Ravi S (QA): I'll create two quick test suites: routing-fallback smoke and cache-consistency regression. Can run in CI as gate for demo branch.

deploy-bot: Reminder: milestone branch deploy scheduled for 2024-09-18T15:00 UTC.

Priya K (PM): Decision: Ship MVP with routing + tenant pinning + regression harness + pilot-scoped prefix cache. Defer global embeddings cache and quantized batched serving to v1. Action items: Gabe -> prefix cache spike + PR (2.5d); Sofia -> harness + gating rule (1.5d); Lena -> console pilot badge + toggle (1d); Ravi -> CI tests (1.5d). I'll file v1 tickets and update the exec slide.

Gabe R (Eng): Starting spike today. Will post draft PR link here when ready.

Sofia M (Eng-ML): Will scope the regression set to 60 prompts targeting critical customer flows.

Lena T (ProdOps): I'll coordinate with Sales for the pilot list.

Priya K (PM): Thanks all. Recheck Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
